notes:
Key account summary:
- Mid-market CX SaaS (customer messaging + knowledge base) evaluating move from hosted -> dedicated for predictable latency and cost.
- Use: conversational support assistant + nearline document search + nightly reindexing for personalization signals.
- POC: Hosted API POC (embeddings + basic chat) completed 2026-01-20. Production-like dataset (150k docs) used for embedding quality checks; results: recall + rerank improvements vs current elastic pipeline.
- Dedicated demo (2026-02-20): 3x A100-like nodes (simulated) — observed median latency ~220ms for 512-token chat responses, p95 ~1.1s under 50 concurrent users. Team happy with determinism but wants tighter p99 SLA for peak windows.
- Performance targets called out by CTO Julian: "Need p50 < 200ms and p99 under 600ms for 1k daily concurrent active users; otherwise customers see latency complaints."
- Cost sensitivity: prefers committed monthly baseline with predictable unit price; asked for burst/overage behavior and detailed cost modeling for caching/batching suggestions.
- Legal/procurement: MSA and DPA are primary negotiation points. Their legal redlines: data residency clause (EU/US segmentation), deletion/retention specifics, right to audit, and liability cap language. Procurement specifically requests: vendor questionnaire, SOC2 + ISO summaries, subprocessor list, and proof of encryption-at-rest (KMS/HSM).
- SLA asks: 99.9% monthly uptime target, clear credit schedule, maintenance window notice >= 48h, and defined fallback behavior (auto-route to hosted fallback model during Dedicated maintenance).
- Onboarding asks: test tenant in customer VPC, SAML SSO for admin console, initial KMS integration for customer-managed keys, and 30-day onboarding support credits.
- Quotes from calls: "We like the output quality but can't trade reliability for lower price" (Head of Product). "Need legal to sign off on DPA before we can move budget" (Finance).
- Current status: legal returned redlines (DPA + MSA). AE coordinating with Legal and SE to produce counter-redline and technical appendix showing network segmentation and audit log retention.
- Next tacticals: legal call week of 2026-03-15, provide SOC2 audit packet, finalize committed capacity and pricing schedule for procurement approval.
- Notes style: shorthand, action items in inbox; see linked drive for pricing deck + filled vendor questionnaire.
